definitions.gloss: cheerfully; brightly; with a refreshed feeling
definitions.explanation: Describes a feeling of relief, joy, or lightness, as if clouds have cleared and the sky is bright. Often used after worries have been resolved or a burden has been lifted.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わって→終わる：00567_owaru⟧、{晴|は}れ{晴|ば}れとした⟦{気分|きぶん}→気分：01306_kibun⟧だ。
examples.english: The exam is over, and I feel so relieved.

examples.japanese: {晴|は}れ{晴|ば}れとした⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せた→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: She showed a bright, cheerful smile.

examples.japanese: ⟦{悩|なや}み→悩み：06650_nayami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}して→解決する：17191_kaiketsusuru⟧{気持|きも}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{晴|は}れ{晴|ば}れ⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My worries were resolved and I felt refreshed.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{晴|は}れ→晴れ：02936_hare⟧ (clear weather, from ⟦{晴|は}れる→晴れる：00701_hareru⟧) reduplicated.
The image is of clear, bright skies after clouds have passed.
- {晴|は}れ{晴|ば}れ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ (adverbial with ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧)
- {晴|は}れ{晴|ば}れとした + noun (adjectival)
- {晴|は}れ{晴|ば}れしい (i-adjective form, literary)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {晴|は}れ{晴|ば}れとした⟦{気分|きぶん}→気分：01306_kibun⟧ - refreshed feeling
- {晴|は}れ{晴|ば}れとした⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ - bright face
- {晴|は}れ{晴|ば}れとした⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧ - cheerful expression
- {気持|きも}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{晴|は}れ{晴|ば}れ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to feel refreshed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦すっきり→すっきり：05180_sukkiri⟧ - refreshed, cleared up (more casual)
- ⟦さっぱり→さっぱり：02777_sappari⟧ - refreshed, clean (after bathing/eating)
- ⟦{爽|さわ}やか→爽やか：05701_sawayaka⟧ - refreshing, fresh

REGISTER:
Neutral to slightly formal. Common in written and spoken Japanese.
